# Release assets for the GitHub release, one glob per line.
#
# This file is the single source of truth. scripts/ci/release-notes.py resolves it
# in the create-release job, release.yml uploads exactly what it prints, and the
# same script fails the release when a shipped file is missing from
# .github/release-notes.md. Adding an artifact here without documenting it in the
# notes is therefore a build failure, not a silently undocumented download.
#
# Placeholders, substituted with the tag name and its bare form:
#   {{VERSION}}      v1.2.3
#   {{VERSION_NUM}}  1.2.3   (Docker tags have no v prefix)
#
# A leading ! excludes matches. The Velopack directories are globbed whole
# because Velopack names its outputs per platform and per release type; the
# exclusions keep internal build files out of the published release.

# Web (Blazor Server), framework-dependent single file
mqttprobe-web-linux-x64-{{VERSION}}.zip
mqttprobe-web-linux-arm64-{{VERSION}}.zip
mqttprobe-web-win-x64-{{VERSION}}.zip

# Desktop and mobile
mqttprobe-windows-{{VERSION}}.zip
mqttprobe-android-{{VERSION}}.apk

# Linux desktop (Photino): the plain zip predates the AppImage and still needs
# WebKitGTK installed, because only the AppImage bundles it.
mqttprobe-desktop-linux-x64-{{VERSION}}.zip

# Licence compliance for the code bundled inside the AppImage
mqttprobe-third-party-sources-{{VERSION}}.tar.gz

# Windows Velopack channel
velopack/*
!*/package-manifest.txt

# Linux Velopack channel
velopack-linux/*
!*/package-manifest.txt

# macOS Velopack channel
velopack-osx/*
!*/package-manifest.txt
